Ol de bilong pinis em ol skelim long sait bilong ol bikpela veliu; ol namba bilong wok yu inap tok bai pinis i stap long sait bilong ol liklik veliu. Dispela i ting namba bilong wok i pinis long bihain bai i klostu olsem bipo; em i no promis. Bikpela tru mak bilong taim: 3,650 de. Sapos i no gat wok i pinis, i no gat skelim bilong bihain.

rule-email-recovery-description: Lukluk gen long ol traim bilong salim imel bilong ol rul ol i bin rekodim. Ol traim i no yet gat tok orait inap i wok yet long salim, o wanpela samting i bin brukim dispela wok. Dispela ripot i no salim gen na i no stopim salim.
rule-email-recovery-unconfirmed: I no yet gat tok orait
rule-email-recovery-sent: Seva bilong imel i kisim pinis
rule-email-recovery-invalid: Ol save i stori long dispela traim i no stret
rule-email-recovery-identifiers: Ol kod bilong makim oda / singaut / traim
rule-email-recovery-empty: I no gat traim bilong salim imel bilong ol rul i stret long dispela painim.
rule-email-recovery-unavailable: No inap lodim ol traim bilong salim imel bilong rul. Lodim gen long traim gen.
rule-email-recovery-dropped: Wanpela admin i stopim dispela salim
rule-email-recovery-recipient-unconfirme: I no yet gat tok orait
rule-email-recovery-actions-hint: WeKan i no save salim gen em yet wanpela imel i no yet gat tok orait olsem em i kamap. Salim gen i go tasol long ol manmeri i no yet gat dispela tok orait. Sapos yu save imel i kamap pinis, makim olsem salim pinis, o stopim dispela salim.
rule-email-recovery-wait: Namba wan salim i ken wok yet. Yu ken makim wanem samting bai yu mekim bihain long __time__.
rule-email-recovery-resends: Ol taim bilong salim gen bipo: __count__
rule-email-recovery-resend: Salim gen long ol manmeri i no yet gat tok orait
rule-email-recovery-resend-confirm: Salim dispela imel gen long ol manmeri i no yet gat tok orait? Sapos seva bilong imel bilong wanpela i kisim pinis tasol i no toksave long WeKan, dispela man o meri bai kisim tupela taim.
rule-email-recovery-mark-sent-confirm: Makim dispela imel olsem salim pinis long olgeta? Mekim dispela sapos yu save em i kamap pinis tasol.
rule-email-recovery-drop-confirm: Stopim salim dispela imel? Em bai i no go long ol manmeri i no yet gat tok orait.
rule-email-resolution-too-early: Namba wan salim i ken wok yet. Traim gen bihain.
rule-email-resolution-resend-in-flight: Wanpela salim gen bilong bipo i ken wok yet. Traim gen bihain.
rule-email-resolution-nothing-to-resend: Olgeta manmeri bai kisim i gat tok orait pinis. Makim olsem salim pinis na no ken salim gen.
rule-email-resolution-resend-uncertain: Seva bilong imel i no bekim tok. Imel yu salim gen i ken kamap pinis o i no kamap; em i soim olsem wok i go yet.
rule-email-resolution-busy: Narapela admin i wok long stretim dispela imel. Traim gen bihain liklik.
rule-email-resolution-command-changed: Imel ol i seivim i no wankain moa wantaim dispela traim, olsem na yu no inap stretim em long hia.
rule-email-resolution-attempt-invalid: Rekod ol i seivim bilong dispela traim i no stret, olsem na yu no inap stretim em long hia.
rule-email-resolution-failed: I no inap stretim dispela imel. Lodim pes gen na traim gen.
rule-email-legacy-heading: Ol imel bilong rul i wet long lukluk gen
rule-email-legacy-description: Ol dispela imel bilong rul i kam long wanpela olpela vesin bilong WeKan i no rekodim as bilong ol tok insait, olsem na WeKan bai i no salim ol em yet. Sekim olsem man o meri i raitim rul i gat rait yet long opim kat, na linkim imel gen bilong redim em long kat olsem em i stap nau, o rausim em.
rule-email-legacy-mail: Ol manmeri bai kisim na het tok
rule-email-legacy-reason-unbound: I no gat rekod bilong ples em i kam long en
rule-email-legacy-reason-details-snapsho: Ol liklik infomesen bilong kat long olpela vesin
rule-email-legacy-rebind-confirm: Redim dispela imel gen long kat olsem em i stap nau? Ol tok insait i ken narakain long ol tok yu redim bipo.
rule-email-legacy-discard-confirm: Rausim dispela imel? Em bai i no inap go long wanpela taim.
rule-email-legacy-empty: I no gat imel bilong rul i wet long lukluk gen.
rule-email-legacy-unavailable: I no inap lodim ol imel bilong rul i wet long lukluk gen. Lodim pes gen bilong traim gen.
rule-email-legacy-access-denied: Man o meri i raitim rul i no gat rait moa long opim dispela kat, o rul i senis, olsem na yu no inap linkim gen. Yu ken rausim imel.
rule-email-legacy-source-changed: Wok i mekim dispela imel i kamap i senis, olsem na yu no inap linkim gen. Yu ken rausim imel.
rule-email-legacy-source-unavailable: Kat dispela imel i kam long en i no stap moa, olsem na yu no inap linkim gen. Yu ken rausim imel.
rule-email-legacy-plan-unavailable: Rekod bilong taim rul i ran na redim dispela imel i no stap moa, olsem na yu no inap linkim gen. Yu ken rausim imel.
rule-email-legacy-attempt-exists: Ol i salim dispela imel pinis, traim salim pinis, o rausim pinis.
rule-email-legacy-not-legacy: Ol i linkim dispela imel gen pinis.
rule-email-legacy-failed: I no inap pinisim dispela wok. Lodim pes gen na traim gen.
saml-login-not-started: Yu no bin statim dispela SAML login long dispela tab bilong brausa. Plis log in gen.
history-request-pending-undo: Seva i no yet tok orait long las senis yu rausim bek.
history-request-pending-redo: Seva i no yet tok orait long las senis yu mekim gen.
history-request-hint: Taim yu traim gen, em i salim dispela wankain askim gen, olsem na em i no inap rausim namba tu senis.
header-login: Go insait long ol heda bilong HTTP
login-setting-clear-secret: Rausim mak ol i seivim long panel bilong admin
login-setting-after-restart: Em i wok bihain long WeKan i stat gen
